$comment: Edited by the dashboard. Restart a workflow for cooldown/wait changes to take effect; URL and reel changes are picked up on the next session only if the workflow is restarted. timesMax 0 means run forever.

targets.name: Instagram views
targets.note: 300 views per order, 5 min limit on the site. 6 min cooldown is deliberate headroom.

targets.name: Instagram likes
targets.note: Only 10 likes per order and a 30 min site limit, so this is ~20 likes/hour against ~3000 views/hour for views. Runs on its own reel, separate from the views session, so the two counts stay separate.
